premises.text: Transaction costs are significantly higher in Africa, and settlement times can be very long
premises.evidence_span: Transaction costs are 15 times higher here and settlement times can last up to 20 days

premises.text: There are many isolated mobile money wallets in Africa, making cross-network payments difficult
premises.evidence_span: more than 155 mobile money wallets running isolated one from another in our continent

premises.text: WeCashUp enables online merchants to accept various payment methods through a single API
premises.evidence_span: WeCashUp is a universal mobile money payment platform that enables online merchants to accept all cash and mobile money wallet online through a single API

premises.text: WeCashUp offers a split payment feature to facilitate payments
premises.evidence_span: we have built a split payment feature that enables us to pay the part that we have and invite our friends

premises.text: WeCashUp supports multiple payment methods including cash, mobile money, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies
premises.evidence_span: now supports cash, mobile money, credit and debit card, bank, mobile wallet and cryptocurrencies

premises.text: WeCashUp has a blockchain tunneling network for secure cross-network payments
premises.evidence_span: we have built the first blockchain tunneling network, which is a global interoperability network that secures and interconnects all these payment channels

premises.text: WeCashUp has onboarded a significant number of merchants in a short time
premises.evidence_span: we already onboarded 4,000 plus merchants in only 10 months with a 100% conversion rate after our six-month trial

value.text: WeCashUp facilitates fast and secure payments for merchants and consumers

notes: Traction metrics and competitive mentions are excluded as they do not represent premises.
